import type { ExtensionAPI } from "@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent";

const ROUTEKIT_EVAL_GATEWAY_SESSION_ID_ENV = "ROUTEKIT_EVAL_GATEWAY_SESSION_ID";
const ROUTEKIT_EVAL_APP_HTTP_REFERER = "https://or.bot";
const ROUTEKIT_EVAL_APP_TITLE = "RouteKitEval";

interface GatewayProviderConfig {
  readonly headers?: Record<string, string>;
}

const buildAttributionHeaders = (
  sessionId: string
): Record<string, string> => ({
  "HTTP-Referer": ROUTEKIT_EVAL_APP_HTTP_REFERER,
  "X-Gateway-Title": ROUTEKIT_EVAL_APP_TITLE,
  "X-Session-Id": sessionId,
});

// This file is materialized standalone and loaded by pi, so it cannot import
// routekit-eval's own env helpers.
const readEnv = (name: string): string | undefined => {
  const value = globalThis.process.env[name]?.trim();
  return value === undefined || value.length === 0 ? undefined : value;
};

const gatewayProviderConfig = (input: {
  readonly sessionId: string | undefined;
}): GatewayProviderConfig =>
  input.sessionId === undefined
    ? {}
    : { headers: buildAttributionHeaders(input.sessionId) };

const register = (pi: Pick<ExtensionAPI, "on" | "registerProvider">): void => {
  const sessionId = readEnv(ROUTEKIT_EVAL_GATEWAY_SESSION_ID_ENV);
  if (sessionId !== undefined) {
    pi.registerProvider(
      "gateway",
      gatewayProviderConfig({
        sessionId,
      })
    );
  }

  pi.on("session_start", (_event, ctx) => {
    const piSessionId = ctx.sessionManager.getSessionId().trim();
    if (piSessionId.length === 0) {
      return;
    }
    pi.registerProvider(
      "gateway",
      gatewayProviderConfig({
        sessionId: piSessionId,
      })
    );
  });
};

export { buildAttributionHeaders, gatewayProviderConfig, register };
export default register;
